title: Smoother
notes: Deep Floors: after Floor 10 every gate continues forever (Floor 11, 12, ...). Stronger enemies, better loot, a boss every 5 floors. The best place to farm.
Combat formation: melee enemies step up to your line and ranged ones stay back, so fights are close and punchy instead of long dashes. Smoother attack movement.
Fairer Arena: hunters are a bit weaker, their recommended Power is shown, and defeats give some Gold and XP.
Recommended Power numbers are now realistic (based on test playthroughs).
Easier gear: a green ▲ marks items that are better than what you wear, and item details show exactly what changes (ATK +45, HP -20, ...).
